--auth.help: Auth mode for the streamable-http transport. Unset → inferred: DECEPTICON_MCP_TOKEN ⇒ shared-secret; --issuer + key ⇒ jwt; else none. The shared-secret value is read only from DECEPTICON_MCP_TOKEN, never argv.

--hmac-key.help: Operator-held HMAC key. Defaults to $DECEPTICON_AUDIT_HMAC_KEY when set; omit both to verify only the hash chain.

--host.help: Bind host for the streamable-http transport.

--instruction.help: Free-form scope or focus instruction passed to the orchestrator.

--root.help: Skill root directory. Defaults to parent of this file.

--sarif-output.help: Path to write SARIF v2.1.0 findings (skipped when unset).

--scope-mode.help: ``diff`` restricts the scan to files changed against --diff-base.

--self-test.help: run the offline grouping check and exit

--since-hours.help: only trajectories newer than N hours

--stix-bundle.help: Path to a pinned MITRE ATT&CK Enterprise STIX 2.1 bundle. Default reads $SKILLOGY_STIX_BUNDLE or ~/.cache/skillogy/mitre/enterprise-attack-19.1.json.

--strict.help: Also scan references/*.md (usually noisy — off by default)
